title: java gui
content: # Working with GUI applications in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} You can develop Java GUI applications in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} easily. To achieve that, you need to install the [Extension Pack for Java](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=vscjava.vscode-java-pack), which includes all the required extensions to develop Java GUI applications. Install the Extension Pack for Java If you run into any issues when using the features below, you can contact us by entering an [issue](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-java-pack/issues).
